findings.label: Stacked modals on the detail sheet's Share
findings.detail: ShareModal is a sibling RN Modal mounted while the detail Modal is still visible. Tap Share inside the detail sheet on device ebbbfc95; if the share sheet comes up blank or behind the detail sheet, add setViewProperty(null) in that handler. Deferral to the device step is accepted.

findings.label: Second card tap dropped silently while one fetch is pending
findings.detail: handleBuilderCardDetails returns early on any non-null detailsId, so tapping card B while card A's getById is in flight does nothing and only A shows a spinner. Either let a new tap supersede the pending one, or disable the other cards' Details while detailsId is set.

findings.label: Group-media rows can carry an empty URL
findings.detail: api.ts getRoomMedia maps a link's url from the first https?:// match in the message content and falls back to '' (media falls back through attachment?.url || content || ''). Such an entry renders a tappable row whose Linking.openURL('') rejects into .catch(() => {}). Drop entries with an empty url when mapping. Only reachable once the backend phase ships GET /group-chat/rooms/:roomId/media.

findings.label: Runtime verification still open
findings.detail: No gradle build, no install, nothing visual; adb screenshots are black on this phone. The five on-device checks (card-body tap opens the sheet; sections with no dash rows and word-form Status; Share from card and from sheet; group info with admins, members and Exit/Delete plus no group 3-dot in the header; 'N members · M projects · Verified') belong to the dedicated verification step after this loop, not to this review gate.
